claims.claim: okay buy and drive to any location
claims.evidence: No video of the engine starting or the motorcycle being ridden.
No shot of the battery, lights, horn, or indicators working.
Purchase receipt or ownership documents not shown in any photo.
No clip of gear shifting or brake lever and pedal operation.
Report does not inspect hidden frame or underbody areas for rust.
No part numbers, manufacturer marks, or original invoices visible.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or run.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start, idle, and throttle response.
Clear photo of the odometer reading.

risks.risk: Ownership or customs documents are missing, or the motorcycle could be stolen.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle registration papers, customs documents, and seller's ID.
risks.if_unproven: priced with no papers and title risk

risks.risk: Hidden accident damage or frame repairs.
risks.proof: Photos of the frame, welds, under-seat area, and both sides of the body.

risks.risk: Battery is dead or electrical system is faulty.
risks.proof: Video of headlight, taillight, indicators, horn, and battery terminals.
risks.if_unproven: priced as battery and electricals faulty

risks.risk: Tires, brakes, or gears are worn beyond visible condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread depth, brake pads, and gear cable movement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing tires, brakes, and gears service

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Photos of ownership or customs documents and seller ID
Close-up photos of frame, tires, brakes, and battery
response.reason: The witness identified the item as a blue motorcycle with AY 100 markings, so it can be valued at its worst case while proof is gathered.
